model.name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
model.about: Anthropic: Claude Sonnet 5, through OpenRouter at $2 in and $10 out per million tokens.

answers.sql: SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 8 AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency, d.CAL_DT AS bus_date, AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, d.CAL_DT ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, d.CAL_DT;

SELECT f.MKT_ID, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_mkt_val, SUM(f.BOOK_VAL1_AMT) AS total_book_val, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID ORDER BY total_mkt_val DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS ACCOUNTS_OPENED
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
 AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
 WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
 AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dcc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dcc ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dcc.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY dcc.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY escalated_complaint_cnt DESC;
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.ACCT_K) AS loans_over_90_dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_txn AS (
  SELECT b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_txn
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K
WHERE dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS transfer_year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT dcc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dcc ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dcc.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY dcc.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY complaint_cnt DESC;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency, d.CAL_DT AS bus_date, AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, d.CAL_DT ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, d.CAL_DT;

SELECT f.MKT_ID, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_net_asset_value, COUNT(*) AS valuation_rows FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;
SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025 GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1 ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

answers.sql:
SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_bus_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K AND dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
